canonical_api.output_contract: out_maze is reset to NULL before validation and receives caller ownership only on success

algorithm.workspace: flat visited bitmap plus explicit heap DFS frames
algorithm.frame: logical cell, one preserved four-direction shuffle, and next-direction index
algorithm.native_stack: constant with respect to logical vertex count
algorithm.randomization: Stage 1 PCG32 draw order and all raster goldens are preserved
algorithm.step_unit: one newly visited logical cell; exactly V on success

validation.dimensions: width and height are odd and at least 3
validation.bounds: the inclusive last coordinate and each dimension must fit int32_t
validation.max_steps: one step per logical cell; default is raster cells times 8
validation.cancellation: polled before generation, throughout raster initialization, and at every frame push
validation.exception_barrier: bad_alloc maps to OUT_OF_MEMORY; callback exceptions map to CALLBACK_FAILED; other exceptions map to CORRUPT_STATE
validation.failure_atomicity: partial Maze output is never published

compatibility.legacy_policy: deprecated ABI 1.x adapter forwarding to the checked generator
compatibility.generic_dispatcher: BYUL_MAZE_ALGORITHM_RECURSIVE_BACKTRACKER produces the same raster for equal options

wrapper.generation_check: generated CFFI declarations are up to date

verification.sdk_consumer: clean-install C17 and C++17 consumers built and ran successfully
verification.standalone_header: clean-install MSVC C17 and C++17 probes passed
verification.strict_header_audit: 150 headers, 95 public C headers, 1172 declarations, 0 invariant errors
